verdict.rationale: Brex exposes REST APIs (Accounting, Payments, Transactions, Team, Webhooks) and webhooks that can be scripted/automated outside a UI, which supports headless/CI-style automation, and Postman/Pipedream/Zapier integration docs further show programmatic, non-interactive usage patterns. However, there is no explicit documentation of a CLI, SDK, service-account/API-key auth flow for CI pipelines, or any first-party guidance on running Brex workflows in automated/headless CI environments. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation guidance, CLI or SDK for scripting, service-account/token auth documentation for non-interactive use, independent confirmation of CI usage.
